about.description: Brale is a US-regulated stablecoin issuance & orchestration platform serving payments platforms, embedded finance, emerging-market ecosystems, and financial institutions. Issues partner-branded stablecoins (MXNe with Etherfuse, cfUSD for Coinflow, etc.) under State Money Transmitter Licensing. Provides reserve management, attestation, multi-chain deployment, and primary mint/redeem rails. SOC 2 certified.
about.registryInfo: Brale Inc. - US-domiciled, State Money Transmitter Licensed (NMLS ID #2376957) regulated stablecoin issuance and orchestration platform. Issues stablecoins for partners (e.g. MXNe in partnership with Etherfuse; cfUSD for Coinflow; supports USDC issuance flows on Base, Arbitrum, Celo). Bankruptcy-remote reserve segregation. SOC 2 compliant.
